in_marathi.name: Panini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Panini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Panini is a Sanskrit name derived from the sage Panini, who is considered the father of Sanskrit grammar and the founder of the Ashtadhyayi, a text on Sanskrit grammar. This name is a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and scholarship.
